candidates.title: Will Taylor Fritz win at least 3.5 more games than Thiago Agustin Tirante?
candidates.rules_primary: If the game differential in favor of Taylor Fritz across the full match is above 3.5 games in the Taylor Fritz vs Thiago Agustin Tirante professional tennis match in the 2026 ATP Stockholm Final, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
The following market refers to the Taylor Fritz vs Thiago Agustin Tirante professional tennis match in the 2026 ATP Stockholm Final. candidates.title: Caleb Douglas Receptions Ladder
candidates.rules_primary: If Each Yes contract pays $0.05 per reception recorded by Caleb Douglas during the Miami vs Indianapolis Pro Football game originally scheduled for Nov 15, 2026. Each No contract pays $1.00 minus the Yes payout. Yes pays out at most $1.00. Then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
This is a scalar market. The Yes payout per contract is $0.05 per reception constrained between $0.00–$1.00 with a cap at 20 receptions. The No payout is $1.00 minus the Yes payout. Payouts are proportional to the size of the holder's position. For example, 8 receptions pays Yes $0.40 and No $0.60; 11 receptions pays Yes $0.55 and No $0.45; zero receptions pay Yes $0.00 and No $1.00.

This Contract is designated as protected. If the individual player participates in at least one play during the first half of the game but does not participate in any play after the conclusion of the first half, including any overtime period, this Contract resolves to the fair price prior to the opening kickoff of the game unless the player records the required number of passing yards, in which case this Contract settles based on actual statistics. If the player participates in at least one play after the conclusion of the first half, this Contract settles based on actual statistics, regardless of first-half participation. Participation in a play nullified by penalty counts. Lining up for a play stopped by a penalty before the snap, without participating in a subsequent play, does not count.
